PRODUCT & DESIGN · PROJECT

AI product teardown: Asana as an OS for human–agent teams

Concepts for how Asana could look if it were built today, with fictional project data.

Has anybody already built an AI-native work manager for humans and agents?

THE PROJECT · 14 SCREENS

The question

If we built Asana or Jira from scratch today, how would it look different?

The approach

Bring work management to where the information already is: work from inside Claude or Codex via MCP, capture decisions from meetings and email, and let agents operate autonomously on the right tasks — without overwhelming existing users.

The tradeoff

Being usable from any assistant makes the product indispensable but risks making the interface irrelevant; visual extensions keep the experience distinct.

What to take with you

An agent can only help with work that makes it back into the system, so remove the typing step entirely.
